name: rainrail
description: Agent-ready development event routing and workflow orchestration suite.

scripts.build: pnpm run build:scripts && pnpm --filter www build && pnpm docs:build && pnpm --filter @rainrail/cli build
scripts.docs:check: node scripts/check-docs-drift.mjs && node scripts/check-docs-routes.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.docs.json && pnpm docs:typecheck
scripts.docs:deploy:preview: pnpm docs:build && wrangler pages deploy apps/docs/dist --project-name rainrail-docs --branch "${RAINRAIL_DOCS_BRANCH:-preview}"
scripts.docs:deploy:production: pnpm docs:build && wrangler pages deploy apps/docs/dist --project-name rainrail-docs --branch main
scripts.e2e:dashboard: pnpm --filter www build && pnpm --filter @rainrail/cli build && playwright test --config playwright.dashboard.config.ts
scripts.pages:deploy:preview: pnpm pages:build && wrangler pages deploy apps/www/dist --project-name rainrail-www --branch "${RAINRAIL_PAGES_BRANCH:-preview}"
scripts.pages:deploy:production: pnpm pages:build && wrangler pages deploy apps/www/dist --project-name rainrail-www --branch main
scripts.test: vitest run scripts src packages apps/www/src/lib
